plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Bachelor of Music Education (BME) graduation plan text PDF. Semester totals as printed: 16 / 16 / 16 / 16 / 15 / 17 / 16 / 13 = 125, matching the printed 'Total Hours 125'. The plan carries the catalog footnote 'See Catalog for Secondary Education Program requirements'. Course titles verified against the official 2025-2026 BME program text PDF: MUSC 1000R Concert Attendance; MUSC 1001 First Year Experience: Music; MUSC 1050 Introduction to World Music (FA); MUSC 1110 Music Theory I; MUSC 1120 Music Theory II; MUSC 1130 Ear Training & Sight Singing I; MUSC 1140 Ear Training/Sight Singing II; MUSC 2110 Music Theory III; MUSC 2120 Music Theory IV; MUSC 2130 Ear Training/Sight Singing III; MUSC 2140 Ear Training/Sight Singing IV; MUSC 2350 Fundamentals of Conducting; MUSC 3630 Music History & Literature I; MUSC 3640 Music History & Literature II; MUSC 3650 Music History and Literature III; MUSC 1730 Vocal Study; MUSC 1740 Percussion Study; MUSC 1750 String Study; MUSC 1760 Brass Study; MUSC 1770 Woodwind Study; MUSC 3222 Choral Conducting / MUSC 3380 Instrumental Conducting; MUSC 4600 Music Rehearsal Techniques; MUSC 4880 Music Education Recital; ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). MUSC 1000R (Concert Attendance, 0 credits) is required every semester in years 1-2, hence allow_repeated_courses with this documented repeat. Slots whose titles are not shown in the graduation plan or program text (MUSC 1700, MUSC 2150R, MUSC 2160R, MUSC 4700/4710, MUSC 18XX/28XX/38XX/48XX private lessons, MUSC ensembles, EDUC 1010/2010/2110/2400/2500/2700, SCED 3720/4100/4200/4300/4600/4900/4989, GE slots) are choice or placeholder entries — see the 2025-2026 catalog course descriptions. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
